_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

objectives.label: Beat off the thieves on the way

title: The domain's takings
Silver for {target}
His lordship's dues
summary: The domain's takings go from {settlement} to {target}, {distance} to the {direction}. Every thief in the county knows the day.
Two mules of silver for {target}, and his lordship trusts his own people to see them there.
The dues of the domain travel to {target} under guard: yours.
offer: The takings leave for {target} today. Two mules, a strongbox, and every cutthroat between here and there counting on them. See them safe, {distance} {direction}.
His lordship's dues go to {target}. Walk with the mules and let nobody near them.
The silver must reach {target}. I can spare no guard but you. Will you see it there?
progress: The mules, the mules: where are they?
complete: Every coin accounted for. His lordship is pleased.
Safe at {target}, and not a bit short. Well done.
The dues are paid. That is a service his lordship will not forget.
